system.description:
Imprisoned in a glacier and still ruling. He understands patience better than anyone alive.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Immunity to cold damage. Once per round, when you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
  • Patron's Mark (4th): For 1 Patron Favour, enter a state of suspended alertness for up to 1 hour — you appear dead to mundane examination, need no food, water, or air, and wake instantly at a trigger you set before entering. Magical detection still functions normally.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, encase one creature within 60ft in magical ice (Fortitude save against your Class Save DC) — paralysed and resistant to all non-fire damage for 1 minute. Repeat save each turn.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Levistus in the World of Arneyan wiki.
